tags.hook_text: Airport lounge ke bahar hamesha aapko 2-3 log aise milenge, jo alag-alag cards nikal rahe hain, swipe kar rahe hain, lekin phir bhi unko lounge access nahi mil raha.
tags.product: FD-backed credit card, free lounge access
tags.one_line: A presenter says most cards have lounge spend limits or lost the perk, then pitches a lifetime-free card from a Stable Money FD with 8 free visits.
